title: Senior lunch program pauses Dec 15
body: Centerville Community Center will stop weekday senior lunches. Alternative meals are listed in Resource Finder.

title: Library hours reduced starting Jan 1
body: Main Library closes Sundays and weeknights at 6 pm. Free Wi-Fi alternatives nearby.

title: City Council budget hearing, Tuesday 7 pm
body: Residents can give public comment on the second reading of the budget. Remote comment is available.

title: Bus Route 12 midday service ending Feb 1
body: No service between 10 am and 3 pm or on weekends. Volunteer ride program can help seniors.

title: Irvington pool closing for the season Oct 31
body: Winter swim lessons and adaptive aquatics are cancelled. Scholarship options available.
